about: Template for the HOST's channel (the person on camera). Copy to channels/<id>.json (id = short lowercase handle, e.g. 'janedoe'), fill every field from the phase-1 interview in docs/START-HERE.md, then set suite.json { "host": "<id>" }. Delete this 'about' line in the copy. Worked example: channels/thebentist.json.
name: <channel name as shown on YouTube>
host: <who is on camera, and the credential or experience that gives them authority>
niche: <what the channel covers, and its main formats (reactions, explainers, stories, Q&A...)>
audience: <who watches: ages, what they care about, why they come>
editing_styles_note: Until /edit-style has measured the host's own videos, the shipped styles are good starting points: story = Huge If True-style (Cleo Abram), reaction = a blend of clip-reaction channels.
transcribe_prompt: <one or two sentences in the host's way of talking, with the names and jargon they use most; helps whisper spell them right>
script_wpm_note: Script words per finished minute when the host records a script. 140 is the original host's measured value; replace it after the first /read-check measures this host.
products: <the host's own products or regular sponsors, if any, and how they like them worked in; or 'none'>
